properties.name: Qumran (Khirbet Qumran)
properties.found: Channel presents the 1947 Judean-desert cliff-cave discovery and treats the Book of Giants (and related Watchers/Nephilim narrative) as Dead Sea Scrolls material from the Qumran/Judean desert caves.
properties.support: Archive notes + transcript for zEW1k0qU8Sg (Book of Giants) and Er507MsGp0M (Book of Enoch) name DSS/Qumran cave discovery; both video ids verified in timothy-alberino-archive all-videos.tsv. Core OT pin QUM-01 already embeds both videos with contested-framing disclosure.
properties.notes: Alberino’s Nephilim/Watchers/catastrophe framing of Dead Sea Scrolls and related texts (Book of Giants, 1 Enoch) is contested versus mainstream archaeology and Second Temple scholarship. DSS discovery locus and presence of Giants/Enoch fragments among the Judean desert finds are channel-presented against a real manuscript background, but interpretive packaging is not dig consensus. Embed as sponsor/channel presentation only. Core QUM pins already carry these embeds with contested-framing disclosure — sponsor chip LINKS those finds; does not pretend excavation consensus. Holy Bible remains canon.
